strategy.name: nasdaq100_point_in_time_strategy1_90_top20_rotation
strategy.description: 对每一只历史时点Nasdaq-100成分证券独立运行已验证的策略1（D0_F0_S0），把当日收盘后策略1模拟账户中的股票市值占比作为分数。只有分数严格高于90%的证券才有资格参与排名；在每个预定调仓收盘从当时已知成分中取分数最高的20只，下一交易日开盘按目标权重完整再平衡。比较1、2、3、5个交易日调仓，以及不足10只时将未满十个10%槽位交给固定Bear9或始终把全部资金等权分配给所有合格股。每条政策同时以单边0和5bps执行，因此共有16条正式路径。历史成分和个股行情来自pending_review候选包，结果只能作探索性证据。
strategy.buy_rule: 每只证券先用自己的完整既有价格历史独立更新策略1；若该证券属于决策日前一交易日已经观察到的Nasdaq-100成分、指标已预热、当日有有效收盘价，而且策略1收盘后股票仓位严格大于90%，它才进入候选。调仓日按该仓位分数从高到低排名，同分按稳定security_id排序，最多选择20只。
strategy.sell_rule: 每个调仓收盘都会重新计算完整目标。分数不再严格高于90%、跌出前20名、或按滞后一交易日的成分状态已经离开指数的证券，在下一交易日开盘降到零；仍入选的证券也恢复到该路径的等权目标。非调仓日不主动改变目标。
strategy.signal_time: 成员资格、策略1仓位分数、排名和目标权重只使用当日已完成的拆股及股息调整Close以及此前信息。为避免把生效日才观察到的InIndex变化倒灌进决策，成员状态统一使用前一XNYS交易日的观察值。
strategy.execution_time: 调仓收盘确认目标，下一XNYS交易日的拆股及股息调整Open先卖出超额份额，再按稳定security_id顺序买入不足份额；允许小数股。成交价分别加入单边0或5bps不利冲击。
strategy.positioning: 最多持有20只合格成分股。FULL_EQUAL路径无论合格数量多少都把100%资金在合格股之间等权分配，零只时持现金。BEAR9_FLOOR10路径在合格股少于10只时每只目标10%，剩余资金按固定Bear9权重配置；达到10只后只持合格股并等权。Bear9尚未上市的权重保留现金，不融资、不做空，现金不计息。

plain_language.summary: 把策略1当作每只历史Nasdaq-100股票的上涨强度评分，定期持有分数最高且超过90%的最多20只。
plain_language.buy: 到调仓日时，只考虑当时已经属于指数、策略1仓位超过90%的股票，并买入其中排名最靠前的最多20只。
plain_language.sell: 股票不再超过90%、跌出前20名或离开当时指数时，在下一次调仓把它卖掉；其余持仓也恢复到新的等权比例。
plain_language.execution: 每天收盘后确认分数和排名，预定调仓日的决定在下一交易日开盘先卖后买；分别查看无成本和单边5bps。
plain_language.position: 主仓最多20只股票；一种路径始终把资金平均分给现有合格股，另一种在不足10只时把空出的十等分槽位交给固定九只防守股票。

signal_engine.score: post-trade strategy1 equity weight in the security at completed Close

universe.security_identity: one source CSV equals one candidate security_id; no unreviewed predecessor merge

parameters.terminal_price_policy: when a selected historical security has no vendor row after its final observation, carry its final adjusted OHLC only as a terminal cash-settlement proxy until the next scheduled rebalance; it cannot receive a new target without a real score row, and only sell orders may use this proxy
parameters.temporary_unavailability_policy: if a security has no real vendor bar on either the rebalance signal session or the intended next-Open execution session, freeze that security's shares for this rebalance and reconsider it only at the next scheduled rebalance with real signal and execution bars

allocation_modes.FULL_EQUAL: if N>0 each selected security receives 1/N; if N=0 remain cash
allocation_modes.BEAR9_FLOOR10: if N>=10 each selected security receives 1/N; if 0<=N<10 each receives 10%, and Bear9 receives 1-N/10

parameters.bear9_prelisting_policy: unavailable positive target weight remains cash and is not redistributed
parameters.rebalance_clock: start at the first analysis Close; every Nth XNYS session is a signal day
parameters.rebalance_scope: restore every selected security and active Bear9 member to the complete current target
parameters.rotation_order: sell excess first by stable instrument_id, then buy deficits by stable instrument_id with available cash
parameters.benchmark: QQQ Buy & Hold enters on the same first executable Open and uses the same cost scenario

financing: disabled; signal-ledger contributions do not enter the tradable portfolio; cash earns zero
benchmark: QQQ Buy & Hold from the same initial decision date and next-Open execution, under the same 0 or 5bps one-sided price impact.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v5 with a 16-path metric table, QQQ-relative equity and drawdown views, eligible-count/exposure diagnostics, and current top-ranked constituents. Keep candidate-data warnings visible in natural language and machine details folded.

research.hypothesis: Strategy1's greater-than-90% virtual position may be a cross-asset trend-intensity score. Ranking only point-in-time Nasdaq-100 members and repeatedly equal-weighting the strongest names may concentrate rising segments, while the Bear9 floor may reduce idle cash when fewer than ten securities qualify.
research.primary_metric: At 5bps compare CAGR, Sharpe, maximum drawdown, turnover, average invested fraction, eligible-count distribution and QQQ-relative return across all four rebalance intervals and both allocation modes; retain 0bps as a friction ablation.
research.selection_rule: Report all 16 predeclared paths and do not rename the highest full-history path as an optimized winner. The 1/2/3/5-day grid, strict 90% gate, top20 cap, ten-slot Bear9 floor, Bear9 assets/weights, point-in-time membership lag and 0/5bps costs are frozen before execution.
research.validation_plan: Unit-test the specialized strategy1 score engine against the source experiment's exact reference ledger; verify strict threshold, lagged membership, deterministic top20 ranking, both under-ten allocation policies, rebalance calendars, no signal-ledger cash leakage, prelisting cash and no future data. Reconcile every formal path between PyBroker and an independent next-Open multi-asset ledger for daily cash/equity, positions, orders, fills and FIFO trades within 1e-6, then run report tests, Chrome interaction, PDF gate, catalog checks, workspace audit and validate_run.
research.promotion_criteria: No path can be promoted while the Nasdaq-100 package remains pending_review or the Bear9 list remains post-hoc. A descriptive candidate should improve 5bps Sharpe and maximum drawdown versus QQQ without reducing CAGR below QQQ, retain direction at 0bps, and show a broad neighboring rebalance-frequency response rather than a single isolated winner. Promotion additionally requires provider/license/acquisition/identity/adjustment review and a separately frozen forward or walk-forward experiment.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject formal or out-of-sample language while the data is pending_review; reject any current-constituent lookback, same-Close portfolio fill, non-strict 90% entry, membership change used without the one-session lag, future availability used in ranking, redistribution of unavailable Bear9 weights, signal-ledger contribution entering portfolio capital, silent security-identity merge, unreported terminal-settlement proxy or unavailable-order deferral, any buy on a synthetic carry bar, incomplete 16-path matrix, cost direction reversal hidden from the report, non-finite ledger value, or ledger mismatch above 1e-6.
